class.name: BehaviorTreeBlackboardCompare
class.brief_description: Compare a Blackboard key against a value or a second key using typed conditions.
class.description: Use as a guard in [BehaviorTreeReactiveSequence] or [BehaviorTreeReactiveSelector] to react to changes in health, distance, time, and other Blackboard values. Supports equality, inequality, ordering of finite numeric values, and key-presence checks. For numeric ordering, both operands must be [code]int[/code] or [code]float[/code]; values such as strings, vectors, booleans, null, NaN, and infinity fail ordering comparisons rather than being silently coerced. When [member use_other_key] is enabled, compares [member key] with the value at [member other_key] rather than [member value]. Missing keys fail except for [constant NOT_EXISTS], which succeeds only when the primary key is absent. [constant EXISTS] succeeds whenever the primary key exists, even if its value is [code]null[/code].

method.name: set_other_key
method.description: Sets the optional second Blackboard key.

method.name: is_using_other_key
method.description: Returns whether another Blackboard key supplies the right-hand value.
